content: He who realizes that he is the witness of the three states of waking, dreaming, and deep sleep is liberated instantly.
author: Adi Shankara
explanation:
In the uncompromising architecture of Advaita Vedanta, Adi Shankara reveals that non-dual consciousness is the eternal reality behind all fleeting phenomena.

This teaching (He who realizes that he is the witness of the three states o...) focuses directly on realizes and that. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
